bingo_tasks.name: Task Bingo
bingo_tasks.description: Everyone gets a bingo card with fun tasks to complete.
bingo_tasks.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Create 5x5 bingo cards with 25 different tasks. Examples: 'Give a stranger a compliment', 'Photo with a police officer', 'Sing a song'. Each participant gets a card and a pen.

**Gameplay:**
The group goes through the city. Everyone tries to complete tasks from their card. Completed squares are checked off. Fellow players can serve as witnesses.

**Rules:**
• First row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) = 'BINGO!'
• All 25 squares = 'Super-BINGO!'
• Each task must be documented with a photo
• No task can be skipped

**Variants:**
• Team Bingo: Two teams compete against each other
• Drinking Bingo: Toast for each completed square
• Speed Bingo: 2-hour time limit

**Tips:**
Mix easy and difficult tasks. The best cards have a good balance between embarrassing and doable tasks!

drink_roulette.name: Drink Roulette
drink_roulette.description: The wheel of fortune decides who drinks.
drink_roulette.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Get a roulette wheel or create one with names/numbers. Set up drinks (shots, beer, or non-alcoholic). Each player gets a number or position assigned.

**Gameplay:**
Taking turns, each player spins the wheel. Whoever the pointer lands on must drink. The spinner can also assign an additional task.

**Rules:**
• Hit twice in a row: Double shot
• Pointer lands on yourself: Everyone else drinks
• 'Joker' field: Player chooses who drinks

**Variants:**
• Task Roulette: Tasks instead of drinking
• Challenge Roulette: Fields with different challenges
• Truth Roulette: Whoever gets hit must answer a question honestly

**Tips:**
For more excitement: Write special actions on some fields like 'Everyone drinks' or 'Waterfall'!

who_am_i.name: Who Am I?
who_am_i.description: Guess the famous person on your forehead through yes/no questions.
who_am_i.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Write names of famous people on sticky notes - for bachelor parties, ideally celebrity couples or theme-related names. Everyone gets a note stuck to their forehead without seeing it.

**Gameplay:**
Taking turns, everyone asks a yes/no question ('Am I female?', 'Am I an actor?'). If 'yes', you can keep asking. If 'no', it's the next person's turn.

**Rules:**
• Only yes/no questions allowed
• Correct guess: New note or you're out
• Maximum 20 questions per round
• No hints from others!

**Variants:**
• Couples Edition: Guess famous couples
• Movie Edition: Only movie characters
• Bachelor Party Special: Exes of the groom/bride

**Tips:**
With large groups, play in teams. Question tips: First clarify gender, then profession, then era!

flunkyball.name: Flunkyball
flunkyball.description: The ultimate outdoor drinking game with ball and bottle.
flunkyball.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Two teams line up about 10 meters apart. Everyone has a drink. In the middle stands a bottle partially filled with water. A soft ball (tennis/softball) is needed.

**Gameplay:**
Team A throws the ball at the bottle. If hit: Team A drinks quickly. Team B must set up the bottle, retrieve the ball, and line up. Then Team A is stopped.

**Rules:**
• Ball must be thrown while sitting
• Only put down drink when all team members are standing
• Bottle must stand upright (not leaning)
• Whoever finishes drinking places bottle upside down
• First team completely finished wins

**Variants:**
• Relay: Only one person per team throws
• Hardcore: Every hit = open a new drink
• Softcore: Water instead of alcohol

**Tips:**
Perfect for parks or gardens! The bottle shouldn't tip over too easily. Sunshine makes the game even better!

beer_pong.name: Beer Pong
beer_pong.description: The classic - throw the ball into your opponent's cups.
beer_pong.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Set up 10 cups per team in pyramid formation (4-3-2-1) on both sides of a long table. Fill each cup one-third with beer. Prepare water cups for cleaning the balls.

**Gameplay:**
Two teams face each other. Taking turns, each player throws a ping pong ball. If it lands in a cup, the opposing team drinks and removes the cup.

**Rules:**
• 'On Fire': 2+ hits in a row = keep throwing
• 'Elbow Rule': Elbow behind table edge
• 'Re-Rack': 1-2 reformations allowed (at 4 or 2 cups)
• Both players hit = balls back
• Opponent may block 'Bounce'

**Variants:**
• Death Cup: Hit into cup still being drunk = instant win
• Bounce Shot: Bounced ball counts double, but can be blocked
• Redemption: Loser can keep throwing until they miss

**Tips:**
The perfect throw has a slight arc. For non-alcoholic version: Water in cups, shots on the side!

groom_bride_quiz.name: Groom/Bride Quiz
groom_bride_quiz.description: How well does the group know the guest of honor?
groom_bride_quiz.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Before the party, collect 20-30 questions about the guest of honor: Favorite things, embarrassing stories, relationship details. The partner can be secretly interviewed. Note the answers!

**Gameplay:**
The moderator asks questions. The group (or the guest of honor) must answer. Wrong answers result in penalties for the guest of honor or the group.

**Rules:**
• Wrong answer = Shot/task for guest of honor
• Correct answer = Shot/task for the group
• Joker: Partner can be called once
• Intimate questions: Guest of honor may refuse (= penalty)

**Variants:**
• Team Quiz: Group vs. guest of honor
• Speed Quiz: 10 seconds per answer
• Photo Quiz: Show pictures from the past

**Tips:**
Mix funny, embarrassing, and romantic questions. The best questions often come from the partner! Document everything for the wedding newspaper!

truth_or_dare.name: Truth or Dare
truth_or_dare.description: The classic for brave confessions and crazy tasks.
truth_or_dare.instructions:
**Preparation:**
No special preparation needed, but prepared questions/tasks make it easier. A spinning bottle is optional. Drinks for refusers should be ready.

**Gameplay:**
Taking turns, everyone chooses: 'Truth' (answer a question honestly) or 'Dare' (complete a task). The previous player or the group asks the question/task.

**Rules:**
• Refusal = Penalty (shot, embarrassing task)
• Can switch once per game
• Truth must be honest (group judges)
• Tasks must not endanger anyone

**Variants:**
• Bachelor Party Edition: All questions/tasks about relationships
• Hardcore: Only dare, no truth
• Dice Version: Even = truth, Odd = dare

**Tips:**
Start harmless and escalate slowly. The best dares are embarrassing but safe. Respect boundaries!

city_rally.name: City Rally
city_rally.description: A scavenger hunt through the city with tasks and puzzles.
city_rally.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Plan a route through the city with 8-12 stations. Create clues leading to the next station. Prepare tasks for each station. Form teams (2-4 people).

**Gameplay:**
Teams start staggered. At each station: Read clue, complete task, take photo, find next clue. The fastest team with all tasks wins.

**Rules:**
• All tasks must be photographed
• Time limit: 2-3 hours
• GPS tracking or calls to game master allowed
• Points for speed + creativity

**Variants:**
• Pub Rally: Stations are bars/pubs
• Photo Rally: Creative photos instead of tasks
• QR Code Rally: Clues via QR code

**Tips:**
Use landmarks as stations. The best rally has a mix of knowledge, action, and fun. End at a bar for the awards ceremony!

never_have_i_ever.name: Never Have I Ever
never_have_i_ever.instructions:
**Preparation:**
All players sit in a circle. Everyone has a drink or 10 fingers/chips. Optional: Prepared statements for the start.

**Gameplay:**
Taking turns, everyone says 'Never have I ever...' and adds a statement. Anyone who has done it drinks a sip or loses a finger/chip.

**Rules:**
• Honesty is mandatory!
• At 0 fingers: Must skip a round or take a special shot
• Follow-up questions allowed: 'Really? Tell us!'
• Caught lying: Penalty drink

**Variants:**
• Bachelor Party Edition: Only relationship/dating topics
• Speed Round: 5 seconds per statement
• Story Mode: Whoever drinks must tell the story

**Tips:**
Start harmless and escalate. The best statements are specific enough to be interesting but not too personal. Respect boundaries!

toilet_paper_dress.name: Toilet Paper Wedding Dress
toilet_paper_dress.description: Create a wedding dress using only toilet paper.
toilet_paper_dress.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Divide the group into teams of 3-4 people. Each team gets 2-3 rolls of toilet paper. Optional: Tape, scissors (makes it easier).

**Gameplay:**
Each team chooses a 'model'. In 10-15 minutes, a wedding dress must be created from toilet paper. The model presents the result on a 'runway'.

**Rules:**
• Strict time limit
• Only provided materials
• Model may not help
• Dress must survive a 'catwalk'

**Variants:**
• With Veil: Bonus for accessories
• Fashion Show: With music and commentator
• Jury Rating: Guest of honor rates

**Tips:**
Wrap the dress around the body rather than just hanging! The best dresses have structure (draping, folds). Don't forget photos!

shoe_game.name: Shoe Game
shoe_game.description: Bride and groom answer questions with shoes.
shoe_game.instructions:
**Preparation:**
The couple sits back to back on chairs. Each holds one of their own shoes and one of their partner's shoes. Moderator has a list of 20-30 questions.

**Gameplay:**
The moderator asks questions ('Who's the better cook?'). The couple raises the shoe of the person the answer applies to - without coordinating.

**Rules:**
• No coordination allowed!
• Same answer: Kiss
• Different answer: Brief explanation
• 3 wrong questions: Penalty task

**Variants:**
• Guest Voting: Audience guesses along
• Drinking Version: Different answer = both drink
• Story Version: Tell a story with each answer

**Tips:**
Mix funny ('Who snores louder?') with romantic questions ('Who said I love you first?'). Perfect for weddings!

mr_mrs_quiz.name: Mr & Mrs Quiz
mr_mrs_quiz.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Create 15-20 questions about the couple. Both partners get signs with 'Him' and 'Her' (or names). Questions pre-agreed with one partner secretly.

**Gameplay:**
The couple sits next to each other. For each question, both hold up the sign for whom the answer applies. The 'correct' answer was predetermined.

**Rules:**
• Show simultaneously (no cheating!)
• Correct answer = Point
• Wrong answer = Penalty task or shot
• Most points wins

**Variants:**
• Guest Edition: Guests guess along
• Relationship Timeline: Questions chronological
• Video Version: Answers were pre-recorded

**Tips:**
Mix embarrassing to romantic questions. The best questions reveal sweet or funny stories. Moderator should follow up!

newspaper_dance.name: Newspaper Dance
newspaper_dance.description: The dance floor gets smaller and smaller!
newspaper_dance.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Each couple gets an unfolded newspaper as their dance floor. Prepare music. Clear space for dancing.

**Gameplay:**
All couples dance on their newspaper. After each round, the newspaper is folded (halved). Whoever steps off the newspaper or falls is eliminated.

**Rules:**
• Both partners must stay on the newspaper
• Lifting partner is allowed!
• Newspaper may not be torn
• Music stops = Fold

**Variants:**
• Freeze Dance: Freeze when music stops
• Balloon Dance: Additionally balloon between bodies
• Speed Version: Fold newspaper every 30 seconds

**Tips:**
The secret: Put partner on your feet or balance on one leg! Perfect for weddings and parties.

wedding_bingo.name: Wedding Bingo
wedding_bingo.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Create bingo cards with typical wedding scenes: 'Someone cries', 'Father of bride speech', 'Child runs through frame', 'Grandma dances'. Each guest gets a card.

**Gameplay:**
During the wedding, guests cross off observed scenes. Whoever completes a row calls 'Wedding Bingo!' and wins a prize.

**Rules:**
• Scenes must actually happen
• Intentional triggering doesn't count
• Row: horizontal, vertical, or diagonal
• Multiple winners possible

**Variants:**
• Full House: All squares for main prize
• Team Bingo: Tables play against each other
• Photo Bingo: Scenes must be photographed

**Tips:**
Cards should be different! Mix inevitable ('Cutting the cake') with rare moments ('Someone spills wine').

polaroid_guestbook.name: Polaroid Guestbook
polaroid_guestbook.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Provide Polaroid camera with enough film. Guestbook/album with blank pages. Pens, glue, and decorations. Props for fun photos.

**Gameplay:**
Guests take Polaroid photos (individuals, couples, groups). Photos are glued into the guestbook and accompanied by personal greetings.

**Rules:**
• Max. 2 photos per guest (film is expensive!)
• At least one greeting per photo
• Use props box
• Let photos dry before gluing

**Variants:**
• Photo Booth: Fixed station with background
• Task Photos: Recreate specific poses
• Video Guestbook: Additionally short videos

**Tips:**
A 'guestbook attendant' helps immensely! Instax cameras are cheaper than real Polaroids. Washi tape instead of glue for nicer decoration!

ring_warming.name: Ring Warming
ring_warming.instructions:
**Preparation:**
The wedding rings are placed on a ribbon or in a small pouch. During the ceremony or reception, it's passed through all guests.

**Gameplay:**
Each guest briefly holds the rings in their hand and silently gives them good wishes, blessings, or positive energy. Then they're passed on.

**Rules:**
• Silent wishes (don't speak aloud)
• Only briefly each (10-30 seconds)
• Don't open/try on the ring
• At ceremony: Rings back to best man

**Variants:**
• Wish Cards: Additionally written wishes
• Blessing Round: Everyone speaks a wish aloud
• Photo Moment: Everyone photographed with ring

**Tips:**
For large weddings, start in multiple rows simultaneously. A helper keeps track. Very emotional moment!

anniversary_dance.name: Anniversary Dance
anniversary_dance.description: Married couples on the dance floor by years.
anniversary_dance.instructions:
**Preparation:**
DJ or moderator prepares a slow song. All married couples are invited to the dance floor.

**Gameplay:**
All couples begin dancing. The moderator asks couples to sit down: 'Those married less than 1 year...' then 5 years, 10, 20, etc. The longest-married couple remains and gives advice.

**Rules:**
• Honest answers!
• Only legally married couples
• The last couple gets a prize
• Often: Short speech or advice for the newlyweds

**Variants:**
• Relationship Dance: All couples, not just married
• Countdown: From long marriage to short
• Interview: Winning couple is interviewed

**Tips:**
Very emotional moment! Often grandparents are the winners. Have tissues ready. Perfect moment for photos!

kiss_marathon.name: Kiss Marathon
kiss_marathon.description: The longest kiss of the evening!
kiss_marathon.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Prepare stopwatch. Guests gather. Optional: Music and cheering. The couple stands in the center.

**Gameplay:**
On command, the couple begins kissing. Guests count the seconds or a moderator times it. Goal: Kiss as long as possible!

**Rules:**
• Lips may not separate
• Breathing through nose is allowed
• No breaking due to laughter
• Guests may cheer

**Variants:**
• Couple Challenge: Multiple couples compete
• Surprise Kiss: Guests call 'Kiss!' when glasses clink
• Break Record: Beat previous record

**Tips:**
Cheering makes it harder (laughing!). World record is over 58 hours - that's not necessary! 1-2 minutes is impressive.

bride_stealing.name: Bride Stealing
bride_stealing.description: The bride is 'kidnapped' and must be ransomed.
bride_stealing.instructions:
**Preparation:**
A group of guests secretly plans the 'kidnapping'. Target location (nearby bar) is scouted. Ransom tasks are prepared.

**Gameplay:**
The bride is 'kidnapped' during the celebration and taken to a bar. The groom must find her and ransom her through tasks or 'payment'.

**Rules:**
• Bride must be informed or consent
• Kidnapping not too early (after dinner)
• Ransom: Tasks, not just money
• Duration: Max. 1-2 hours

**Variants:**
• Bar Rally: Multiple bars as stations
• Task Ransom: Each task = one step closer
• Team Rescue: Groom + groomsmen

**Tips:**
All guests should know what's happening. The bride should really consent! Best coordinated with restaurant/DJ.

charades.name: Charades
charades.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Write terms on slips (movies, celebrities, actions). Form teams (3-6 people). Prepare timer (60-90 seconds per round).

**Gameplay:**
One player draws a term and acts it out - no words, sounds, or pointing at objects. The team guesses. On hit: Next term.

**Rules:**
• No speaking, humming, or sounds
• Don't point at objects
• Showing syllables with fingers allowed
• Time per round: 60-90 seconds
• Points per guessed term

**Variants:**
• Themed Charades: Only movies, only professions
• Speed Charades: 30 seconds per term
• Reverse: Everyone mimes, one guesses

**Tips:**
Learn common gestures: 'Movie' (crank camera), 'Book' (open hands), 'Song' (mime singing). The crazier the performance, the funnier!

activity.name: Activity
activity.description: Explain, draw, or act out - versatile party game.
activity.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Terms on cards (or buy Activity game). Form teams. Provide drawing materials. Timer (30-60 seconds).

**Gameplay:**
Depending on the card, the term must be explained (without related words), drawn, or acted out. The team guesses within time.

**Rules:**
• Explaining: Don't say the word
• Drawing: No letters or numbers
• Pantomime: No sounds
• Per hit: 1 point
• Wrong method: 0 points

**Variants:**
• Speed Mode: All methods in one round
• Bachelor Party Edition: Only relationship terms
• Drinking Activity: Wrong guess = Drink

**Tips:**
Mix easy and difficult terms. The funniest moments come from difficult pantomimes. Use a large drawing surface!

taboo.name: Taboo
taboo.description: Explain the term without using the forbidden words.
taboo.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Prepare Taboo cards: Each card has a term and 5 forbidden words below. Form teams. Prepare timer.

**Gameplay:**
One player explains the term without using the taboo words or their word stems. An opponent monitors. The team guesses.

**Rules:**
• Taboo word said = Term lost
• No 'Rhymes with...' or spelling
• Opponent can call 'Taboo!'
• 60 seconds per round
• Points per guessed term

**Variants:**
• Expert Mode: 7 taboo words
• Speed Taboo: 30 seconds
• Themed Rounds: Only movies, only sports

**Tips:**
Circumlocutions and stories work well. 'Imagine...' is a great opener. The taboo words are the obvious ones - be creative!

cards_against.name: Cards Against Humanity
cards_against.description: The card game for horrible people.
cards_against.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Get card deck (or print online). Each player receives 10 white cards. Black cards as a pile in the middle.

**Gameplay:**
A 'Card Czar' draws a black card and reads it aloud. Everyone else plays a white card that fits best. The Czar chooses the winner.

**Rules:**
• The Czar changes each round
• White cards played anonymously
• Winner keeps the black card
• For __ & __, play two white cards
• Czar's decision is final!

**Variants:**
• Drinking Version: Everyone except winner drinks
• Democracy: Everyone votes
• Haiku: Three cards into a story

**Tips:**
The Czar determines the humor! Some like clever, others love shocking. Play with people who understand dark humor.

scavenger_hunt.name: Scavenger Hunt
scavenger_hunt.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Plan 8-15 stations with clues. Each clue leads to the next location. At the end, a 'treasure' awaits. Form teams or play together.

**Gameplay:**
Teams start with the first clue. Each clue is a puzzle that must be solved to find the next location. Until the goal!

**Rules:**
• Follow the order
• No help from outsiders
• All team members must be present
• Photos at each station as proof
• First team at goal wins

**Variants:**
• Photo Hunt: Photo tasks instead of locations
• QR Code Hunt: Digital clues
• Night Hunt: With flashlights

**Tips:**
Clues should be tricky but solvable. A mix of knowledge, searching, and creativity. The 'treasure' can be snacks, drinks, or a surprise!

murder_mystery.name: Murder Mystery Dinner
murder_mystery.description: Solve the murder case while you dine.
murder_mystery.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Buy Murder Mystery set or create your own. Distribute roles to guests (in advance!). Decoration matching the theme. Plan dinner.

**Gameplay:**
During a multi-course dinner, everyone plays their role. Clues are revealed, suspects questioned. At the end, the murderer must be unmasked.

**Rules:**
• Everyone stays in character
• Murderer may lie, others may not
• Clues given at specific times
• Discussion and questioning allowed
• At the end: Vote

**Variants:**
• 1920s Gatsby Murder
• Crime Dinner at restaurant
• Outdoor: Murder at the castle

**Tips:**
Distribute roles in advance so guests can prepare. Costumes make it more authentic. Plan 3-4 hours!

kubb.name: Viking Chess
kubb.description: The Scandinavian throwing game for all ages.
kubb.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Mark playing field (5x8 meters). Set up five Kubbs per side. King in the middle. Distribute throwing sticks (6 pieces per team).

**Gameplay:**
Teams take turns throwing at the opponent's Kubbs. Knocked-over Kubbs are thrown into the opponent's field and set up there. Goal: Hit all Kubbs, then the King.

**Rules:**
• Throw sticks underhand (helicopter forbidden)
• First hit all field Kubbs, then base Kubbs
• King hit too early = lost!
• Throwing stick must land upright

**Variants:**
• Speed Kubb: Time limit per round
• Drinking Kubb: Hit Kubb = Opponent drinks
• Team Tournament: Multiple teams

**Tips:**
Strategy is important: Throw Kubbs close together for chain reaction. Be careful with the King - many games were lost this way!

sack_race.name: Sack Race
sack_race.description: The classic for every family celebration.
sack_race.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Potato sacks or large trash bags for each participant. Mark start and finish lines (10-20 meters). Obstacles optional.

**Gameplay:**
All participants get into the sacks and hold them with both hands. On command, hop to the finish. First to arrive wins.

**Rules:**
• Hands must stay on the sack
• Fall = Get up and continue
• Sack may not be torn
• No pushing
• Crossing finish line counts

**Variants:**
• Relay Sack Race: Teams with handover
• Obstacle Course: With slalom
• Pair Sack Race: Two people, one sack

**Tips:**
Smaller hops for balance rather than big jumps. Play on soft ground (grass). Start children and adults separately for fairness!

egg_and_spoon.name: Egg and Spoon Race
egg_and_spoon.description: Balance the egg on the spoon to the finish.
egg_and_spoon.instructions:
**Preparation:**
For each participant: A spoon and a raw egg (or hard-boiled/plastic). Mark start and finish lines (15-20 meters).

**Gameplay:**
The egg sits on the spoon, held by one hand at the handle. On command, everyone runs to the finish. If the egg drops: Back to start.

**Rules:**
• Only one hand on the spoon
• Other hand behind the back
• Stabilizing egg with hand = Disqualification
• Dropped egg: Back to start
• First intact egg at finish wins

**Variants:**
• Relay: Teams with handover
• Obstacle Course: With curves and hurdles
• Water Egg: Spoon with water instead of egg

**Tips:**
Slow and steady is better than fast! Don't stare at the egg - look ahead. Hard-boiled eggs for less chaos!

musical_chairs.name: Musical Chairs
musical_chairs.description: When the music stops, sit down fast!
musical_chairs.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Set up chairs in a row or circle - always one fewer than players. Prepare music (with pause option).

**Gameplay:**
Everyone walks around the chairs while music plays. When music stops: Sit down quickly! Whoever doesn't get a chair is out. One chair is removed.

**Rules:**
• Don't touch or reserve before music stops
• Sit immediately when music stops
• No pushing
• Must sit on chair (not just touch)
• Last player with chair wins

**Variants:**
• Music Freeze: Freeze when stopped, don't sit
• Team Version: Pairs play together
• Dance-Off: Eliminated players keep dancing

**Tips:**
Music controller shouldn't watch! Unpredictable pauses make it more exciting. Set up chairs stably!

kiss_challenge.name: Kiss Challenge
kiss_challenge.description: Collect kisses from strangers - the more the better!
kiss_challenge.instructions:
**Preparation:**
Get white t-shirt for the guest of honor. Provide various colored lipsticks. Don't forget disinfecting wipes!

**Gameplay:**
The guest of honor must collect kisses (lipstick prints) from strangers on the t-shirt. The group accompanies and documents everything.

**Rules:**
• Only voluntary kisses count!
• Respectful asking is mandatory
• Different colors = Bonus
• No harassment!
• Time limit: 1-2 hours

**Variants:**
• Photo Kiss: Selfie with each person
• Signatures: Additionally collect names
• Challenge Escalation: Find specific 'types'

**Tips:**
Always ask friendly and respectfully. Accept 'no'! Bars and clubs work best. The t-shirt is a great souvenir!

selfie_mission.name: Selfie Mission
selfie_mission.description: Strike a pose! Complete creative selfie challenges with specific prompts.
selfie_mission.instructions: Everyone gets a list of selfie challenges (e.g. with a police officer, on a fountain, etc.). Whoever completes the most wins!

costume_tasks.name: Costume Challenges
costume_tasks.description: Dress up in wild costumes and tackle hilarious tasks.
costume_tasks.instructions: The guest of honor must complete tasks out in public while wearing an embarrassing costume. The group documents everything!

bucket_list.name: Bucket List Challenge
bucket_list.description: Tick off unforgettable experiences from a pre-made bucket list.
bucket_list.instructions: Create a list of once-in-a-lifetime experiences. Try to check off as many as possible before the day is done!

karaoke_battle.name: Karaoke Battle
karaoke_battle.description: Sing your heart out and compete for glory — pitch-perfect not required!
karaoke_battle.instructions: Teams or solo performers face off against each other. The crowd votes. Bonus points for stage presence and sheer bravery!

photo_scavenger_hunt.name: Photo Scavenger Hunt
photo_scavenger_hunt.description: Snap everything on the list — and get creative about it!
photo_scavenger_hunt.instructions: Each team receives a list of photo challenges. Points are awarded for creativity and how many you complete.

team_olympiad.name: Team Olympiad
team_olympiad.instructions: Set up a variety of competitions (sack race, egg-and-spoon, etc.). Teams earn points along the way. A winner is crowned at the end.

boot_camp.name: Boot Camp Challenge
boot_camp.description: A full-group fitness challenge that'll push you to the limit.
boot_camp.instructions: A trainer or the group itself leads everyone through a series of exercises. Who can keep up? Teamwork makes the dream work!

cocktail_contest.name: Cocktail Contest
cocktail_contest.description: Who can mix the most amazing drink?
cocktail_contest.instructions: Everyone crafts their own signature cocktail. A blind tasting and group vote determine the winner. May the best bartender win!

wine_tasting.name: Blind Wine Tasting
wine_tasting.description: Put your palate to the test — can you identify the wines?
wine_tasting.instructions: Various wines are tasted and rated blind. Earn points for correctly guessing grape varieties or regions.

tshirt_design.name: T-Shirt Painting
tshirt_design.description: Design a one-of-a-kind group tee to remember the day.
tshirt_design.instructions: Use fabric paints to turn plain tees into personalized works of art. The perfect keepsake from an unforgettable day!

embarrassing_songs.name: Embarrassing Song Sing-Off
embarrassing_songs.description: Belt out the most cringe-worthy songs in public — loud and proud!
embarrassing_songs.instructions: The guest of honor must sing selected embarrassing songs out loud and with full passion at public locations.

dare_dice.name: Dare Dice
dare_dice.description: Roll your fate — the dice decide your challenge!
dare_dice.instructions: Roll the dare dice. Whatever it lands on, you have to do it. No excuses!

ring_search_pasta.name: Find the Ring in the Pasta
ring_search_pasta.description: Dig through a bowl of pasta blindfolded to find the hidden ring.
ring_search_pasta.instructions: A ring is hidden in a large bowl of pasta. Blindfolded, you have to find it using only your mouth or hands.

balloon_dance.name: Balloon Dance
balloon_dance.description: Dance with a balloon between you — don't let it drop!
balloon_dance.instructions: Pairs dance with a balloon held between them. If the balloon drops or pops, that pair is out.

limbo_competition.name: Limbo Contest
limbo_competition.instructions: The bar gets lower and lower with each round. The player who makes it under the lowest point without touching the bar or falling wins!

pinata.name: Piñata
pinata.description: Smash the piñata and grab all the candy!
pinata.instructions: Swing away at the piñata while blindfolded until it bursts open and candy rains down!

mystery_box.name: Mystery Box
mystery_box.description: Feel what's inside the box — no peeking!
mystery_box.instructions: Different objects are hidden inside boxes. Players must reach in blindfolded and guess what they're touching.

hat_challenges.name: Hat Challenges
hat_challenges.description: Draw a challenge and do it on the spot.
hat_challenges.instructions: Challenges are written on slips of paper and tossed into a hat. Players take turns drawing one and completing it right away.

photo_booth.name: Photo Booth Challenge
photo_booth.description: Strike wild poses with hilarious props.
photo_booth.instructions: Set up a photo area with fun props. Everyone tries to snap as many silly photos as possible. The best shots win a prize!

speed_dating.name: Speed Dating Game
speed_dating.description: Get to know everyone in the group in just 2 minutes.
speed_dating.instructions: Everyone chats with each other person for 2 minutes. When the timer rings, rotate to the next! Afterwards: who remembered what about whom?

who_knows_best.name: Who Knows Them Best?
who_knows_best.description: Find out who really knows the guest of honour.
who_knows_best.instructions: Questions about the guest of honour are asked. Whoever answers the most correctly is the true #1 fan!

pictionary.name: Pictionary
pictionary.description: Draw and guess terms against the clock.
pictionary.instructions: Draw the term so your team can guess it. No letters or symbols allowed!

rage_cage.name: Rage Cage
rage_cage.description: A fast-paced drinking game with cups and balls.
rage_cage.instructions: Bounce your ball into the cup as fast as you can and pass it on. If you get lapped, you have to drink from the middle stack!

flip_cup.name: Flip Cup
flip_cup.description: Drink and flip your cup faster than the other team.
flip_cup.instructions: Chug your cup and flip it upside down with one finger. Only once it lands can the next player go!

escape_room_diy.name: DIY Escape Room
escape_room_diy.description: Build your very own escape room experience.
escape_room_diy.instructions: Prepare puzzles and codes in advance. The team must solve them all to 'escape'. Beat the clock!

casino_night.name: Casino Night
casino_night.description: Poker, blackjack, roulette — bring the Las Vegas vibes!
casino_night.instructions: Set up gaming tables for the evening. Everyone starts with a stack of chips. At the end, who's sitting on the biggest fortune?

drag_race.name: Drag Race
drag_race.description: Give each other the most fabulous makeovers.
drag_race.instructions: Teams style and glam each other up. The most jaw-dropping transformation wins. Runway walk included!

dance_off.name: Dance-Off
dance_off.description: Show off your best moves in an epic dance battle.
dance_off.instructions: Two players go head-to-head on the dance floor. The group votes for the winner. The winner faces the next challenger.

lip_sync_battle.name: Lip Sync Battle
lip_sync_battle.description: It's all about the performance — no singing required!
lip_sync_battle.instructions: Pick a song and give it everything you've got! Your lip sync has to be on point. Showmanship is everything!

twerk_contest.name: Twerk Contest
twerk_contest.description: Who's got the best twerk in the room?
twerk_contest.instructions: Turn up the music and show off your moves! The group votes for the winner. Don't be shy!

pole_dance_intro.name: Pole Dance Intro
pole_dance_intro.description: A taste of pole dancing for first-timers.
pole_dance_intro.instructions: Visit a studio or book a mobile class. Learn your first moves with a professional instructor. Fun guaranteed!

strip_poker_light.name: Strip Poker Light
strip_poker_light.instructions: Losers remove one item of clothing — or complete a dare instead. Set your boundaries before you start!

dirty_minds_quiz.name: Dirty Minds Quiz
dirty_minds_quiz.description: Just how dirty is your mind?
dirty_minds_quiz.instructions: The clues sound naughty, but the answer is totally innocent! Anyone who falls for the dirty answer has to drink.

last_night_freedom.name: Last Night of Freedom
last_night_freedom.description: The ultimate checklist for your last night as a free agent.
last_night_freedom.instructions: Work through a pre-made list of all the classic bachelorette/bachelor party challenges. Document everything!

family_feud.name: Family Feud
family_feud.description: Guess the most popular survey answers.
family_feud.instructions: Teams compete. For each question, guess the most popular answers. Points for hits!

family_bingo.name: Family Bingo
family_bingo.description: Classic bingo fun for the whole family.
family_bingo.instructions: Numbers or pictures are called out one by one. First to complete a row shouts 'Bingo!' Prizes for the winners.

memory_challenge.name: Memory Challenge
memory_challenge.description: Test your memory by matching pairs of cards.
memory_challenge.instructions: Lay the cards face down. Flip them over to find the matching pairs. Whoever finds the most pairs wins!

family_quiz.name: Family Quiz
family_quiz.description: How well do you really know your family?
family_quiz.instructions: Answer questions about family members and shared memories. Score points for every correct answer!

time_capsule.name: Create a Time Capsule
time_capsule.description: Collect memories to treasure in the future.
time_capsule.instructions: Everyone adds something meaningful to the capsule. Seal it up and set a date to open it together!

can_knockdown.name: Can Knockdown
can_knockdown.instructions: Stack the cans into a pyramid and try to knock them all down with a ball. Score points for every can you topple.

boccia.name: Bocce Ball
boccia.description: A classic precision game with balls.
boccia.instructions: Toss your balls as close to the target ball as possible. The closest ball scores the points!

tug_of_war.name: Tug of War
tug_of_war.instructions: Two teams grab opposite ends of a rope and pull with all their might. The team that drags the other over the line wins!

relay_race.name: Relay Race
relay_race.description: A team racing challenge with a baton.
relay_race.instructions: Teams run a course and pass the baton. The fastest team wins!

water_balloon.name: Water Balloon Battle
water_balloon.description: Wet and wild fun for hot days.
water_balloon.instructions: Fill up water balloons and let them fly. Mix it up: throw, catch, or just embrace the chaos!

cooking_together.name: Cook Together
cooking_together.description: Team up to cook a festive feast.
cooking_together.instructions: Split into groups. Each group prepares one course. Then sit down together and enjoy the fruits of your labor!

puzzle_race.name: Puzzle Race
puzzle_race.description: Which team can solve the puzzle first?
puzzle_race.instructions: Every team gets the same puzzle. On your marks, get set, puzzle! The fastest team takes the win.

campfire_stories.name: Campfire Stories
campfire_stories.description: Gather around the fire and share your stories.
campfire_stories.instructions: Take turns telling stories — spooky, hilarious, or straight from the family archives. Perfect for evening get-togethers!

hide_and_seek.name: Hide and Seek
hide_and_seek.instructions: One person counts while everyone hides. The last one found wins!

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Run as fast as you can!
tag.instructions: One person is 'it'. Whoever they tag becomes the new 'it'. The fun never stops!

pot_hitting.name: Pot Hunt
pot_hitting.instructions: Blindfolded and armed with a wooden spoon, find the hidden pot. A surprise is waiting underneath!

telephone.name: Telephone
telephone.description: How much will the message change?
telephone.instructions: Whisper a message down the line. At the end, compare what was sent vs. what arrived — usually hilarious!

chocolate_game.name: Chocolate Frenzy
chocolate_game.description: Roll a six and eat as fast as you can!
chocolate_game.instructions: Roll a 6: put on the hat, scarf, and gloves, then eat the chocolate with a knife and fork — until someone else rolls a 6!

cotton_blowing.name: Cotton Ball Blowing
cotton_blowing.description: Blow the cotton ball across the table.
cotton_blowing.instructions: Place a cotton ball in the center. Everyone tries to blow it onto the other team's side.

mummy_wrap.name: Mummy Wrap
mummy_wrap.description: Wrap someone in toilet paper as fast as you can.
mummy_wrap.instructions: Teams wrap a teammate head to toe in toilet paper. The fastest team with the most impressive mummy wins!

treasure_hunt.name: Treasure Hunt
treasure_hunt.description: Follow the map to the treasure!
treasure_hunt.instructions: A treasure map leads to a series of stations, each with a clue. At the end, the treasure awaits!

mini_golf.name: Mini Golf
mini_golf.description: Classic mini golf fun for all ages.
mini_golf.instructions: Head to a mini golf course. Whoever finishes with the fewest strokes wins!

bowling.name: Bowling
bowling.description: Strike! Knock down every last pin.
bowling.instructions: Roll the ball down the lane and try to knock down all the pins. Score a point for every pin you topple!

frisbee.name: Frisbee
frisbee.description: Toss the disc back and forth.
frisbee.instructions: Head to the park or beach and start throwing and catching the frisbee. Simple, breezy, and a total blast!

kite_flying.name: Kite Flying
kite_flying.description: Send colorful kites soaring into the sky.
kite_flying.instructions: Find a breezy day and get your kite airborne. Who can fly it the highest? Perfect for a windy autumn afternoon!

bubble_contest.name: Bubble Blowing Contest
bubble_contest.description: Who can blow the biggest bubble?
bubble_contest.instructions: Grab some bubble solution and a variety of wands, then see who can make the most gigantic bubble. Pure magic for the little ones!

photo_safari.name: Photo Safari
photo_safari.description: Snap everything on the list out in nature.
photo_safari.instructions: Hand out a list of things to photograph, then head outside to hunt and snap them. Score points for every find!

geocaching.name: Geocaching
geocaching.instructions: Use a geocaching app to track down hidden caches in your area. A real adventure the whole family will love!

crafting.name: Crafting
crafting.description: Get creative with all kinds of materials.
crafting.instructions: Set out a spread of craft supplies and let your imagination run wild. From paintings to handmade jewelry — anything goes!

talent_show.name: Talent Show
talent_show.instructions: Everyone prepares a short act, then performs for the crowd. The winner gets voted on at the end. Absolutely anything is allowed!

millionaire_family.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire (Family Edition)
millionaire_family.description: The ultimate quiz-show format for the whole family.
millionaire_family.instructions: Questions get tougher as you climb the ladder. Lifelines are fair game: Phone a Friend, 50/50, Ask the Audience!

escape_room_family.name: Family Escape Room
escape_room_family.description: Solve the puzzles together and break free!
escape_room_family.instructions: Pick up an at-home escape room kit or visit one near you. Work together to crack every puzzle before the clock runs out!

treehouse_build.name: Build a Treehouse
treehouse_build.description: A fun shared project for the whole family.
treehouse_build.instructions: Plan and build your very own treehouse together. Spread it across a few weekends and enjoy an amazing result everyone can be proud of!

marriage_test.name: Marriage Fitness Test
marriage_test.description: Hilarious challenges put couple skills to the test.
marriage_test.instructions: The couple must tackle a series of fun challenges: changing a diaper, feeding each other blindfolded, and more!

balloon_dancing.name: Balloon Dancing
balloon_dancing.description: Dance as a pair with a balloon squeezed between you.
balloon_dancing.instructions: Couples dance with a balloon held between them. If it drops or pops, that couple is out!

bouquet_toss.name: Bouquet Toss
bouquet_toss.description: Which lucky single lady will catch the bouquet?
bouquet_toss.instructions: All unmarried women gather on the dance floor. The bride tosses the bouquet over her shoulder — whoever catches it is next to walk down the aisle!

garter_toss.name: Garter Toss
garter_toss.description: The groom takes his shot at the single guys.
garter_toss.instructions: The groom removes the bride's garter and tosses it into the crowd of single men — who will be the lucky one?

wedding_abc.name: Wedding ABC
wedding_abc.description: A wish or piece of advice for every letter of the alphabet.
wedding_abc.instructions: Guests write a wish or piece of advice for the couple for each letter of the alphabet — from A all the way to Z!

guest_lottery.name: Guest Lottery
guest_lottery.description: Every guest has a shot at amazing prizes!
guest_lottery.instructions: Lottery tickets are handed out upon arrival. Throughout the evening, lucky winners are drawn for prizes!

wish_tree.name: Wishing Tree
wish_tree.description: Hang your wishes on the tree.
wish_tree.instructions: Guests write heartfelt messages on little cards and hang them on a decorative tree — a beautiful keepsake and stunning decoration in one!

date_night_jar.name: Date Night Jar
date_night_jar.description: Fun ideas for future date nights.
date_night_jar.instructions: Guests jot down date ideas on slips of paper and drop them into a jar. The couple picks one out whenever they need date night inspiration!

advice_cards.name: Advice Cards
advice_cards.description: Words of wisdom straight from the guests.
advice_cards.instructions: Cards with space for heartfelt advice are laid out for guests to fill in. The couple reads them together later for a touching keepsake.

couple_quiz.name: Couple Quiz
couple_quiz.description: How well do the guests really know the couple?
couple_quiz.instructions: Questions about the couple are read aloud and guests write down their answers. Whoever knows the most wins the crown!

wedding_limbo.name: Wedding Limbo
wedding_limbo.description: How low can you go in your finest outfit?
wedding_limbo.instructions: The limbo bar keeps getting lower and lower. Last one to make it through without falling wins the glory!

musical_chairs_wedding.name: Musical Chairs
musical_chairs_wedding.description: The classic party game hits the dance floor!
musical_chairs_wedding.instructions: Arrange chairs in a circle — always one fewer than the number of players. When the music stops, grab a seat fast!

conga_line.name: Conga Line
conga_line.description: Everyone in a line, dancing through the party!
conga_line.instructions: Crank up the music, put your hands on the shoulders of the person in front, and let the conga snake through the whole venue!

wedding_karaoke.name: Wedding Karaoke
wedding_karaoke.description: Sing your heart out for the happy couple!
wedding_karaoke.instructions: Set up a karaoke machine and let guests serenade the newlyweds. Bonus points for bravery — boldness will be rewarded!

first_dance_game.name: First Dance Surprise
first_dance_game.description: A surprise twist on the first dance.
first_dance_game.instructions: The first dance gets a fun upgrade — surprise style changes, genre switches, or a fully choreographed routine that wows the crowd!

wedding_photo_challenge.name: Photo Challenge
wedding_photo_challenge.instructions: A list of scenes to photograph. Guests snap the shots and share them!

guest_interview.name: Guest Interviews
guest_interview.instructions: A camera is set up and ready to go. Guests get interviewed and record their personal video messages!

love_story_reading.name: Reading the Love Story
love_story_reading.instructions: The best man, maid of honor, or family members share how the couple first met.

wedding_tombola.name: Wedding Raffle
wedding_tombola.instructions: Tickets go on sale and prizes are drawn. The proceeds can be donated to a good cause!

bridal_shoe_hiding.name: Hide the Bridal Shoe
bridal_shoe_hiding.description: The shoe gets hidden and must be ransomed back.
bridal_shoe_hiding.instructions: Kids or guests hide the bride's shoe. The groom has to 'buy it back' to get it!

piggy_bank_game.name: Piggy Bank Game
piggy_bank_game.description: Guests toss coins into piggy banks.
piggy_bank_game.instructions: Two piggy banks: 'Who does the dishes?' – 'Who takes out the trash?'. Guests vote with their coins!

wedding_bet.name: Wedding Bets
wedding_bet.description: Place bets on the happy couple.
wedding_bet.instructions: Guests bet on it all: Who cries first? When does the cake topple? Who's the last one dancing?

song_request_cards.name: Song Request Cards
song_request_cards.instructions: Cards are laid out for guests to write down their song requests. The DJ plays them all!

wedding_time_capsule.name: Wedding Time Capsule
wedding_time_capsule.description: Memories sealed away for the future.
wedding_time_capsule.instructions: Guests and the couple place their memories into a capsule. Open it on your 10th anniversary!

congratulation_line.name: Congratulations Line
congratulation_line.description: An organized way for all guests to offer their congratulations.
congratulation_line.instructions: Guests line up one by one to offer a quick congrats. A host keeps things moving along!

two_truths_lie.name: Two Truths and a Lie
two_truths_lie.description: Guess the lie among three statements.
two_truths_lie.instructions: Everyone tells three facts about themselves - two true, one false. The group must guess the lie!

speed_meeting.name: Speed Meeting
speed_meeting.description: Get to know people fast with a rotating format.
speed_meeting.instructions: Like speed dating, but just for getting to know each other. 2 minutes per person, then rotate!

human_bingo.name: Getting-to-Know-You Bingo
human_bingo.description: Find people who match the descriptions on your card.
human_bingo.instructions: Bingo cards filled with traits ('Has a pet', 'Speaks 3 languages'). Find someone who fits each one!

find_someone_who.name: Find Someone Who…
find_someone_who.description: Seek out people with specific traits.
find_someone_who.instructions: A list of criteria to work through. Find someone who matches each one and get their signature!

common_ground.name: Find Common Ground
common_ground.description: What do we all have in common?
common_ground.instructions: In small groups: find as many things you have in common as possible. The group with the most wins!

story_cubes.name: Story Cubes
story_cubes.description: Roll the dice and spin a tale.
story_cubes.instructions: Roll the picture dice and weave a story from whatever symbols come up!

name_ball.name: Name Ball
name_ball.description: Learn everyone's name with a toss.
name_ball.instructions: Call out someone's name and toss the ball to them. They call the next name!

word_association.name: Word Association
word_association.instructions: One person says a word, the next says the first thing that pops into their head. No repeats!

personality_quiz.name: Personality Quiz
personality_quiz.instructions: Take a quick personality test, then compare and discuss your results!

desert_island.name: Desert Island
desert_island.instructions: Everyone picks 3–5 items they'd take to a desert island and explains why. You'll learn so much about each other!

would_you_rather.name: Would You Rather...?
would_you_rather.instructions: Take turns asking questions. Everyone must choose and explain their pick!

rose_bud_thorn.name: Rose, Bud, Thorn
rose_bud_thorn.description: Share your highlights, hopes, and challenges.
rose_bud_thorn.instructions: Everyone shares: a Rose (something good), a Bud (a hope), and a Thorn (a challenge).

hot_seat.name: Hot Seat
hot_seat.description: All questions are aimed at one person.
hot_seat.instructions: One person takes the 'hot seat' and answers questions from the group. Honesty is everything!

one_word_story.name: One-Word Story
one_word_story.description: Build a story together — one word at a time.
one_word_story.instructions: Go around and each person adds one word. Together you'll create a (usually hilarious) story!

human_knot.name: Human Knot
human_knot.instructions: Everyone stands in a circle and grabs two random hands. Then untangle the knot without letting go!

alphabet_introduction.name: Alphabet Introductions
alphabet_introduction.description: Introduce yourself with an adjective and your name.
alphabet_introduction.instructions: Everyone introduces themselves with an adjective that starts with the same letter as their name!

interview_pairs.name: Interview Pairs
interview_pairs.description: Interview each other and introduce your partner.
interview_pairs.instructions: Pair up, interview each other, then introduce your partner to the whole group!

favorites_lineup.name: Favorites Lineup
favorites_lineup.description: Line up according to your preferences.
favorites_lineup.instructions: Line up based on the prompts: from 'early bird' to 'night owl', from 'pizza lover' to 'sushi fan'!

emoji_introduction.name: Emoji Introduction
emoji_introduction.instructions: Pick 3–5 emojis that describe you. Then explain your choices to the group!

show_and_tell.name: Show and Tell
show_and_tell.description: Share something personal that means a lot to you.
show_and_tell.instructions: Everyone brings along a meaningful object and shares the story behind it!

trust_fall.name: Trust Fall
trust_fall.description: Fall backward — your team will catch you.
trust_fall.instructions: One person falls backward and the group catches them. A great way to build trust!

blind_drawing.name: Blind Drawing
blind_drawing.description: Draw by following instructions — without seeing a thing!
blind_drawing.instructions: One person describes what to draw. The other draws it completely blindfolded!

marshmallow_challenge.name: Marshmallow Challenge
marshmallow_challenge.description: Build the tallest tower using spaghetti and a marshmallow.
marshmallow_challenge.instructions: Use spaghetti, tape, and string to build a tower. A marshmallow must sit right on top!

egg_drop.name: Egg Drop Challenge
egg_drop.description: Protect an egg from the fall.
egg_drop.instructions: Build a protective casing for an egg using available materials. Then drop it from height. Will the egg survive?

minefield.name: Minefield
minefield.description: Guide your partner through obstacles — blindfolded.
minefield.instructions: One partner is blindfolded, the other can only give verbal instructions. Don't touch the obstacles!

80s_retro.name: 80s Retro Party
80s_retro.description: Neon colors, synth music and shoulder pads
80s_retro.tips: Think neon lights, disco balls and 80s hits from A-ha to Madonna!

90s_throwback.name: 90s Throwback
90s_throwback.description: Grunge, boy bands, and the very first mobile phones
90s_throwback.tips: Use album covers as decorations, break out the Walkman props, and queue up everything from Backstreet Boys to Nirvana!

casino_royale.name: Casino Royale
casino_royale.description: Elegant James Bond atmosphere with gaming tables
casino_royale.tips: Red carpet, poker chips, gaming tables and elegant cocktails!

tropical_beach.name: Tropical Beach
tropical_beach.description: Caribbean flair with palm trees and cocktails
tropical_beach.tips: Hawaiian shirts, tiki torches, coconut drinks and tropical music!

dirndl_lederhosen.name: Dirndl & Lederhosen
dirndl_lederhosen.description: Bavarian tradition with pretzels and beer steins
dirndl_lederhosen.tips: Beer benches, Oktoberfest music, pretzels and beer steins!

superhero.name: Superhero Party
superhero.tips: Capes required, comic-book décor, and an epic superhero playlist!

murder_mystery_theme.name: Murder Mystery
murder_mystery_theme.description: A murder has been committed — who did it?
murder_mystery_theme.tips: Dim lighting, mysterious music, costumes, and clue cards!

white_party.name: White Party
white_party.tips: White decorations, white flowers, light-colored cocktails, and chilled lounge music!

black_tie.name: Black Tie Gala
black_tie.description: Formal and elegant — tuxedos and evening gowns
black_tie.tips: Champagne, classical music, and stunning table decorations!

festival_style.name: Festival Style
festival_style.description: Outdoor festival vibes with flower crowns
festival_style.tips: Boho decor, fairy lights, chill-out corners, and live music or a DJ!

oktoberfest.name: Oktoberfest
oktoberfest.description: O'zapft is! Bavarian coziness at its finest
oktoberfest.tips: Beer benches, pretzels, white sausage, brass band music, and lederhosen/dirndl dress code!

mexican_fiesta.name: Mexican Fiesta
mexican_fiesta.tips: Sombreros, piñatas, colorful banners, margaritas and salsa music!

gatsby_20s.name: Gatsby / 1920s
gatsby_20s.description: The roaring twenties with flappers and jazz
gatsby_20s.tips: Art deco decor, champagne, feather boas, swing music and Charleston!

pirates.name: Pirate Adventure
pirates.tips: Treasure maps, eye patches, rum cocktails, and Jolly Roger flags!

wellness_retreat.name: Wellness Retreat
wellness_retreat.tips: Candles, relaxing music, face masks, tea and wellness snacks!

sports_day.name: Sports Day
sports_day.description: Olympic-style fun and friendly athletic competitions
sports_day.tips: Jerseys, medals, playing fields, and champion-worthy snacks!

game_night.name: Game Night
game_night.description: Board games and card games for everyone
game_night.tips: Cozy seating areas, tons of games, snacks, and drinks!

garden_party.name: Garden Party
garden_party.description: An elegant celebration in the great outdoors
garden_party.tips: Floral decor, parasols, picnic baskets, and light bites!

bbq_grill.name: BBQ & Grill
bbq_grill.tips: Grill, garden bench, string lights, and all the BBQ classics!

cocktail_party.name: Cocktail Party
cocktail_party.tips: A bar station, cocktail menu, jazz music, and elegant appetizers!

wine_cheese.name: Wine & Cheese
wine_cheese.description: Wine tasting paired with fine cheeses
wine_cheese.tips: A variety of wines, a cheese board, grapes, and soft background music!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

meta.title: Privacy Policy | EventBliss
meta.description: How EventBliss (MYFAMBLISS GROUP LTD) processes your personal data under the GDPR — recipients, legal bases, retention periods and your rights.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we — MYFAMBLISS GROUP LTD, the operator of EventBliss — collect, use, share and protect your personal data when you use our app (iOS and Android), our website event-bliss.com and the EventBliss marketplace. It also explains your rights under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). EventBliss is built to be privacy-friendly: we process only what is needed to run the service, we do not sell your data and we do not show third-party advertising.

summary.title: At a Glance
items: We only process the data needed to run EventBliss — your account, your events and, if you buy Premium, your purchase data.
Our database, authentication and file storage run on Supabase in the EU (Frankfurt, Germany).
Payments are handled by Apple, Google and Stripe — we never see or store your full card details.
AI features (receipt scanner, planning assistant, read-aloud) only transmit data while you actively use them — and never for advertising purposes.
We do not sell personal data and we do not use third-party advertising or tracking networks.
You can delete your account at any time in the app (Profile → Settings → Delete account) — see 'Account Deletion'.

controller.title: Controller
controller.content:
Controller within the meaning of Art. 4(7) GDPR for all processing described in this policy is:

MYFAMBLISS GROUP LTD is a company registered in the Republic of Cyprus. "EventBliss" is a brand and product of MYFAMBLISS GROUP LTD. We have not appointed a data protection officer, as we are not legally required to do so; for all privacy matters you can reach our team directly using the contact details below.

dataCategories.title: What Data We Process
dataCategories.intro: Depending on how you use EventBliss, we process the following categories of personal data. We collect them directly from you, from your device, or they arise from your use of the service:

account.label: Account data
account.desc: Display name, email address, password (stored only as a salted cryptographic hash by our authentication provider), profile picture, language and notification preferences. If you sign in with Apple or Google, we receive your name (or a pseudonym), your (relay) email address and a technical account identifier from that provider.

content.label: Event content
content.desc: Everything you and your guests create inside an event: event name, type, dates, location, guest list, tasks, schedules, polls and votes, chat messages, photo gallery uploads, expense entries and game results. Event content is visible to the other participants of that event.

payment.label: Purchase and payment data
payment.desc: Your subscription status (Free, Premium, Lifetime), product identifiers, transaction and purchase tokens from Apple or Google, and — for web purchases — the data processed via Stripe (amount, currency, payment method type, last four card digits). Full card numbers are processed exclusively by the payment providers and never reach our servers.

receipts.label: Receipt photos (expense scanner)
receipts.desc: If you use the receipt scanner in the expense feature, the photo you take and the recognised data (merchant, amount, date) are processed to pre-fill the expense entry. See 'Recipients and Processors' for the OCR provider involved.

usage.label: Usage data
usage.desc: Which features you use and basic interaction events (e.g. event created, game started), crash reports and performance diagnostics. We use this to keep the app stable and to improve it — not to build advertising profiles.

device.label: Device and log data
device.desc: IP address, device model, operating system and version, app version, browser type, time stamps of requests and — if you enable notifications — your push token. Server logs are kept for security and troubleshooting.

location.label: Location data (optional)
location.desc: Only when you use map features (e.g. picking an event location): the map section you view and, if you grant the system permission, your approximate device location for centring the map. We do not create movement profiles and we do not track your location in the background.

voice.label: Read-aloud / audio (optional)
voice.desc: When you use the read-aloud (text-to-speech) feature, the text to be spoken is transmitted to our speech provider to generate the audio. We do not access or record your microphone for this feature.

purposes.title: Purposes and Legal Bases (Art. 6 GDPR)
purposes.intro: We process your data only for the following purposes and only on these legal bases:

service.purpose: Providing the EventBliss service: your account, event planning and collaboration, synchronisation across devices, marketplace bookings and customer support.
service.basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — performance of the contract (our Terms of Service).

payments.purpose: Processing purchases and subscriptions (Premium, Lifetime, marketplace bookings), issuing receipts and preventing payment fraud.
payments.basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR; for tax and commercial record-keeping additionally Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.

ai.purpose: AI-supported features: receipt text recognition (OCR), the AI planning assistant and text-to-speech output. Data is transmitted to the providers listed under 'Recipients and Processors' only at the moment you actively use the feature.
ai.basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — the feature is part of the service you request. Where required, we additionally ask for your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

push.purpose: Push notifications about your events (e.g. new messages, tasks or schedule changes).
push.basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR — your consent via the system permission dialog; revocable at any time in your device settings.

security.purpose: Security and abuse prevention: server logs, rate limiting, fraud detection, defence against attacks and enforcement of our Terms.
security.basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — our legitimate interest in a secure, trustworthy platform.

legal.purpose: Compliance with legal obligations, in particular statutory retention periods for transaction and accounting records.

processors.title: Recipients and Processors
processors.intro: We share personal data only with the following recipients, only to the extent necessary, and — where they act as our processors — on the basis of data processing agreements pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR. Apple, Google, Stripe and Spotify act (partly) as independent controllers for their own services.

supabase.name: Supabase
supabase.purpose: Database, authentication and file storage — the technical backbone of the app
supabase.safeguards: Processor; DPA pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR; data hosted in the EU

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.purpose: Hosting and content delivery of the website event-bliss.com
vercel.safeguards: DPA with EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs); EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.purpose: Payment processing for purchases on the website (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA)
stripe.safeguards: DPA with SCCs; certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

apple.name: Apple
apple.purpose: In-app purchases on iOS, Sign in with Apple, push notifications (APNs)
apple.safeguards: Independent controller for purchases; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

google.name: Google
google.purpose: In-app purchases on Android (Play Billing), Google Sign-In, push notifications (FCM), Google Maps
google.safeguards: Independent controller for purchases; SCCs; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

revenuecat.name: RevenueCat
revenuecat.purpose: Subscription management and validation of in-app purchases (receives a pseudonymous user ID and purchase tokens)

openai.name: OpenAI

openai.safeguards: Processor; DPA with SCCs; API data is not used to train models

mistral.safeguards: Processor; DPA pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR

spotify.safeguards: Independent controller; Spotify's own privacy policy applies

mapbox.purpose: Map display — your IP address and the requested map tiles are transmitted when a map loads
mapbox.safeguards: DPA with SCCs; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (Google)

chatbase.purpose: Support chatbot on the website; processes the messages you enter in the chat

allinkl.name: ALL-INKL.COM (SMTP)
allinkl.purpose: Delivery of transactional and notification emails (e.g. booking confirmations, newsletter confirmation)

transfers.title: International Data Transfers
transfers.content: Where recipients are located outside the European Economic Area (in particular in the USA), we ensure an adequate level of data protection through: (a) the EU Commission's adequacy decision for the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (Art. 45 GDPR) for certified providers, and (b) the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR) including supplementary measures where required. Copies of the relevant safeguards are available on request via the contact details below.

retention.title: Storage Periods
retention.intro: We store personal data only for as long as necessary for the respective purpose or as required by law:

account.label: Account data
account.desc: Stored for as long as your account exists and deleted when you delete your account.

events.label: Event content
events.desc: Deleted when you delete the event or your account; residual copies are removed from encrypted backups within 30 days.

payments.label: Payment and transaction records
payments.desc: Retained for 6 years after the end of the relevant financial year, as required by the Cyprus Companies Law and tax legislation.

logs.label: Server and security logs
logs.desc: Automatically deleted or anonymised after 30 days, unless a specific security incident requires longer retention.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.content: EventBliss uses only technically necessary cookies and local storage entries: your login session, your language selection and interface preferences (e.g. theme). Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR or — for storage covered by the ePrivacy rules — strict necessity to provide the service you request. We do not use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Should an optional, non-essential technology be introduced in the future, we will ask for your consent first (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). The support chat (Chatbase) only loads once you actively start it — no connection to Chatbase is made before that.

push.title: Push Notifications
push.content: We send push notifications (e.g. new chat messages, tasks or schedule changes in your events) only if you allow them in the system permission dialog. Delivery is handled by Apple (APNs) on iOS and Google (FCM) on Android, which receive a technical push token for your device. You can revoke your consent at any time: on iOS under Settings → Notifications → EventBliss, on Android under Settings → Apps → EventBliss → Notifications — or simply disable individual notification types directly in the app.

purchases.title: Purchases, Subscriptions and Payment Data
purchases.content:
In-app purchases (iOS/Android): Premium subscriptions and the Lifetime purchase are processed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play) as independent controllers. We receive confirmation of the purchase and pseudonymous transaction data, but no payment details. RevenueCat validates purchases and manages the subscription status on our behalf.

Web purchases: On event-bliss.com payments are processed by Stripe. Stripe processes your payment details in accordance with payment regulation; we only receive the result, the amount and a reference.

We never store full card numbers; statutory retention duties apply to transaction records (see 'Storage Periods').

deletion.title: Account Deletion
deletion.content: You can delete your account directly in the app at any time: Profile → Settings → Delete account. This permanently deletes your account data and the events you own; copies in encrypted backups are purged within 30 days. Data subject to statutory retention duties (e.g. payment records, see 'Storage Periods') is blocked from any other use and deleted once the retention period expires. Alternatively, you can request deletion by emailing support@event-bliss.com from your account email address. Note: subscriptions purchased via Apple or Google must be cancelled separately in your App Store / Google Play subscription settings — deleting your account does not cancel them automatically.

rights.title: Your Rights (Art. 15–21 GDPR)
rights.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data. To exercise them, an informal email is sufficient — we respond within one month at the latest (Art. 12(3) GDPR):

access.label: Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR)
access.desc: You can request confirmation of whether and which data we process about you, and obtain a copy of that data together with the information listed in Art. 15.

rectification.label: Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR)
rectification.desc: You can have inaccurate data corrected and incomplete data completed — most account data can be edited directly in the app.

erasure.label: Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR)
erasure.desc: You can request the deletion of your data; the easiest way is the in-app account deletion (see 'Account Deletion').

restriction.label: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
restriction.desc: In the cases listed in Art. 18 (e.g. while the accuracy of contested data is being verified), you can require us to restrict processing.

portability.label: Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
portability.desc: You can receive the data you provided in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format. Download it directly in the app under Profile → Settings → “Export my data”, or request the export by email to support@event-bliss.com.

objection.label: Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR)
objection.desc: You can object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to processing based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. We will then stop processing unless compelling legitimate grounds prevail.

withdraw.label: Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7(3) GDPR)
withdraw.desc: Where processing is based on your consent (e.g. push notifications), you can withdraw it at any time with effect for the future.

rights.complaint: Right to lodge a complaint (Art. 77 GDPR): You may complain to a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your habitual residence or place of work. The authority responsible for us is the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Cyprus, 1 Iasonos Street, 1082 Nicosia, Cyprus — dataprotection.gov.cy.

children.title: Children and Minors
children.content: EventBliss is not directed at children. Creating an account requires a minimum age of 16 (or the lower age your member state has set for information society services, but never below 13). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children below this age. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We protect your data with technical and organisational measures pursuant to Art. 32 GDPR: TLS encryption for all data in transit, encryption at rest for the database and file storage, row-level security so that every user can only access their own events, role-based access controls for our team, the principle of least privilege for service keys, and regular review of our security measures. No system is 100% secure, but we work continuously to keep the risk as low as possible.

changes.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.content: We update this policy when our service, our providers or the legal situation change. The current version with the date stated above always applies; material changes will be announced in the app or by email. Earlier versions are available on request.

acceptance.content: By accessing or using EventBliss, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Each booking confirms that you have read and accepted these Terms.

services.title: Our Role as a Platform
services.content:
EventBliss operates an online marketplace where independent event agencies offer their services (e.g. DJs, photographers, catering, decoration, venues).

Important: EventBliss acts as an intermediary and is NOT the contractual provider of the booked service. The service contract is concluded exclusively between you (the customer) and the respective agency. EventBliss provides the technical infrastructure, payment processing, communication, support and dispute resolution.

booking_process.title: Booking Process & Contract Formation
booking_process.content:
1. Request: You choose an agency/service and submit a booking request with date, details and your contact information.

2. Confirmation: The contract with the agency is formed either (a) when the online payment via Stripe is successfully completed (automatic confirmation) or (b) when the agency manually confirms your request (for on-site payment bookings).

3. Performance: The agency delivers the service on the agreed date. EventBliss is not involved in the delivery itself but coordinates communication via the platform.

Right of withdrawal for distance contracts (§§ 312g, 355 BGB): As a consumer you generally have a 14-day right of withdrawal. Exception: for date-bound leisure services (§ 312g (2) No. 9 BGB) – which applies to virtually all event services with a fixed date – the statutory right of withdrawal does not apply. The service-specific cancellation policy (see Cancellation) applies additionally and is more customer-friendly.

All communication with the agency runs through the platform chat. Please keep communication there so it is documented in case of dispute.

payment_methods.title: Payment Methods
payment_methods.content:
EventBliss supports two payment methods. Availability is decided by each agency per service:

• Online payment (Stripe): Credit card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA direct debit and other country-specific methods. Payment is instant and secured by Stripe as a PCI-DSS-compliant payment service provider. You receive an automatic booking confirmation and receipt by email after successful payment.

• On-site payment (on_site): You pay the price directly to the agency on the event day (or as agreed) in cash or via an agreed method. The listed price is binding – the agency may not demand more than stated in the booking. The booking is confirmed by manual agency confirmation via the platform.

Total price & platform fee: All prices on EventBliss are final prices including applicable VAT (where the agency is VAT-registered) and the 10 % platform fee. This fee is settled internally between the agency and EventBliss; you only pay the displayed total price.

Payment issues: For problems with online payments (e.g. failed charges, chargebacks) or on-site payments (e.g. price deviations) contact support@event-bliss.com. EventBliss mediates in either case – including for on-site bookings.

payment.title: Payment Terms & Settlement
payment.content:
For online payments, the total amount is charged immediately upon booking. Release to the agency occurs after service delivery according to the payout schedule (typically 24–72 hours after the event) to allow refunds in case of disputes.

For on-site payments, no amount is charged in advance. Payment is made directly to the agency.

Receipts & invoices: For online payments you automatically receive a Stripe payment confirmation and – if provided by the agency – an invoice in your booking area. For on-site payments, the agency is required to issue a receipt/invoice.

Default interest and further costs for late payment follow the statutory rules (§§ 286, 288 BGB).

cancellation_refund.title: Cancellation & Refunds
cancellation_refund.content:
Each agency sets a cancellation policy per service. It is transparently shown before you complete a booking. Three tiers exist:

• flexible: Full refund up to 7 days before the event, 50 % thereafter.
• moderate: Full refund up to 14 days before the event, 50 % until 7 days, none thereafter.
• strict: 50 % refund up to 30 days before the event, none thereafter.

Refund method: For online payments, refunds are automatically returned to your original payment method. Depending on your bank or card issuer, the credit appears within 5 to 14 days.

On-site bookings: Since no money has flowed through EventBliss, cancellations are settled directly with the agency. The agreed cancellation policy still applies. In case of disagreement EventBliss mediates; contact support@event-bliss.com with your booking number.

Force majeure & special cases: If the agency is unable to perform (e.g. illness, official restrictions), the full amount is refunded regardless of the cancellation tier.

Agency-caused non-performance: If the agency fails to show up or delivers grossly defective service, EventBliss buyer protection applies. Report the incident within 48 hours of the scheduled date with evidence to support@event-bliss.com – if substantiated, you receive a full refund.

off_platform_bypass.title: Platform Bypass Protection
off_platform_bypass.content:
Agencies on EventBliss are contractually obliged to process ALL bookings that originated on the platform through the platform. This protects you as a customer and ensures you receive all buyer protection benefits.

What is NOT allowed: An agency may NOT contact you – particularly after a cancellation, but also during initial contact – to arrange a booking off-platform (e.g. via WhatsApp, phone, email, cash payment, direct bank transfer) to avoid the platform fee. Such attempts are a breach of contract by the agency toward EventBliss.

Why you should refuse such offers: By going off-platform you lose all EventBliss protections:

• No buyer protection: No refund in case of non-performance, damage or fraud.
• No support: EventBliss cannot help you because no contract runs through the platform.
• No documented communication: No traceable evidence in case of dispute.
• No review & identity verification: The platform can no longer vouch for reliability.
• Tax concerns: Cash payment without a proper invoice can cause trouble for both sides.

Reporting bypass attempts: If an agency contacts you directly and offers you an off-platform booking (e.g. "Pay me 200 € in cash and we'll save the fee"), please report it immediately to compliance@event-bliss.com. Helpful items: screenshot of the message, booking/service ID, time of contact.

Thank-you credit: As a token of appreciation, after verification we will credit you with 20 % off your next EventBliss booking (max. 200 € value, redeemable within 12 months).

Confidentiality: Your report is treated confidentially. The reported agency will not learn who submitted the report.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Activities
prohibited.content:
You agree not to use the platform for illegal, fraudulent or harmful purposes. In particular, the following is prohibited:

• Misuse of payment methods (e.g. unjustified chargebacks after the service was rendered online, refusal to pay for on-site bookings).
• Abusive, discriminatory or threatening behavior toward agencies or staff.
• Review manipulation (e.g. fake reviews, blackmailing with negative reviews).
• Providing false information in bookings (e.g. false identity, fraudulent payment methods).
• Using the platform to broker illegal content, services or products.
• Bypassing the platform yourself after initial contact via EventBliss (see "Platform Bypass Protection").

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content:
As a platform operator, EventBliss is liable only for damages resulting from intent or gross negligence, as well as for injury to life, body and health according to statutory provisions.

The quality, timeliness and contractual conformity of the booked service are the sole responsibility of the respective agency – EventBliss is not the service provider.

However, EventBliss voluntarily grants buyer protection on online payments (see Cancellation & Refunds) and mediates in case of disputes, also for on-site bookings.
