changes.content: We may update these Terms to reflect legal changes or new features. Material changes will be announced to you by email at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use after they take effect constitutes acceptance.

inAppPurchases.title: Premium, Subscriptions & In-App Purchases
inAppPurchases.content:
EventBliss offers optional paid plans (Premium as an auto-renewing subscription, Lifetime as a one-time purchase). They can be bought as in-app purchases via the Apple App Store or Google Play, or on event-bliss.com via our payment provider Stripe.

Auto-renewal: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period at the price shown at purchase, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Cancelling store purchases: Subscriptions bought in the app are managed exclusively through your Apple App Store or Google Play account (iOS: Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions; Android: Google Play → Payments & subscriptions). EventBliss cannot cancel store subscriptions on your behalf. After cancellation, Premium remains active until the end of the paid period; pro-rata refunds are governed by the respective store's terms.

Web subscriptions: Subscriptions purchased on the website can be cancelled at any time with effect from the end of the current billing period, via your account or by emailing support@event-bliss.com.

Lifetime: The Lifetime option is a one-time purchase without recurring fees. It grants access to the Premium features for the operating life of EventBliss; it is not a guarantee of perpetual operation of the service.

Price changes: Price changes for subscriptions apply only to subsequent periods and will be announced in advance; for store purchases the notification and consent procedures of Apple/Google apply.

All prices are displayed to you before purchase, including applicable VAT, in the respective store or on the website. Premium comprises the features stated in the app, including the monthly AI credit allowance (see section 'AI Credits').

aiCredits.title: AI Credits
aiCredits.content:
Premium plans include a monthly allowance of AI credits for AI features (e.g. AI assistant, receipt scanning). The applicable allowance is stated at the time of purchase and on the Premium page in the app.

Credits are consumed per AI request. The allowance automatically resets on the 1st of each calendar month; unused credits do not carry over to the following month. Credits are tied to your account, are non-transferable, cannot be redeemed for cash and have no monetary value. Upon cancellation or expiry of your Premium plan, unused credits lapse at the end of the period already paid for.

We may adjust the allowance for future billing periods with reasonable advance notice. Your right to cancel and your statutory rights remain unaffected.

vouchers.title: Vouchers and Promotional Codes
vouchers.content:
Promotional vouchers and discount codes (e.g. from marketing or partner campaigns) are voluntary benefits. The conditions communicated at the time of issue apply, in particular the validity period, minimum order value and scope of redemption.

Unless stated otherwise in the individual case: only one voucher may be redeemed per person and per order; multiple promotions cannot be combined; redemption is only possible before completing the order process. Vouchers have no cash redemption value, do not bear interest and may not be resold or passed on commercially.

In the event of a refund, the amount actually paid is refunded first; a redeemed promotional voucher is not reinstated unless the law provides otherwise. In cases of abuse (e.g. multiple accounts, automated redemption, manipulation of the distribution channel), we may block vouchers and reverse any benefits obtained through such abuse. Your statutory rights remain unaffected.

suspension.title: Suspension and Termination by EventBliss
suspension.content:
If you materially breach these Terms (in particular the section 'Prohibited Activities'), we may issue a warning and, if the breach continues, temporarily suspend your account, or terminate the contractual relationship for cause in the event of serious or repeated breaches.

We may suspend your account without prior warning where this is necessary to protect other users or the security of the platform, or to comply with legal obligations — for example in cases of suspected fraud, legal violations or security incidents.

We will inform you of a suspension and its essential reasons to the extent legally permitted, and you may request a review and state your position via support@event-bliss.com.

In the event of a termination for which you are responsible, periods already paid for will not be refunded to the extent legally permissible. Your mandatory statutory rights — including the refund rules of the Apple App Store and Google Play for purchases made there — remain unaffected.

affiliate.content:
For participants in our affiliate or partner program, the following applies in addition:

Commissions accrue exclusively for qualified purchases that were referred via your personal link or code and that are not withdrawn, refunded or charged back. The commission rates, payout thresholds and payout periods shown in your partner dashboard at the time of the referral are decisive. Changes apply only to future referrals and will be announced in the dashboard with reasonable notice.

The following in particular are not permitted: self-referrals via your own or affiliated accounts, misleading advertising claims, infringements of trademarks or other protected rights, paid search engine advertising on our brand terms, and any technical manipulation. Violations result in the forfeiture of commissions not yet paid out and may lead to exclusion from the program.

You are solely responsible for the taxation of commissions you receive.

withdrawal.title: Right of Withdrawal (EU Consumers)
withdrawal.content:
Digital content & Premium (purchase on our website): As a consumer in the EU you generally have a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal. For purchases of digital content / digital services on event-bliss.com, the right of withdrawal expires when we begin performance immediately after purchase with your express consent and your acknowledgement that you thereby lose your right of withdrawal (Art. 16(m) of Directive 2011/83/EU; in Germany § 356(5) of the Civil Code). You give this consent during checkout; Premium is activated immediately.

In-app purchases: For purchases made via the Apple App Store or Google Play, the refund and withdrawal procedures of Apple or Google apply; requests must be addressed to the respective store.

Marketplace services: When booking event services you generally also have a 14-day right of withdrawal. Exception: for services related to leisure activities with a specific date or period of performance — which applies to virtually all event services booked for a fixed date — the right of withdrawal is excluded under Art. 16(l) of Directive 2011/83/EU (implemented in Germany in § 312g(2) no. 9 of the Civil Code). Independently of the statutory right of withdrawal, the service-specific cancellation policy applies (see 'Cancellation & Refunds') — it is in many cases more generous.

Exercise: Where a right of withdrawal exists, you can declare withdrawal informally within 14 days of contract conclusion (e.g. by email to support@event-bliss.com).

userContent.content:

You grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce and display this content solely to the extent necessary to operate the service (e.g. showing photos to the other participants of your event, creating backups). This licence ends when you delete the content or your account, except for residual copies in backups (purged within 30 days) and content you shared with other users that they legitimately retain.

We may remove content that violates these Terms or applicable law and will inform you of the removal where legally required (see also the notice-and-action procedures under the Digital Services Act).

marketplaceCancellation.content: Cancellations of booked event services are governed by the service-specific cancellation policy (flexible, moderate or strict) that the agency assigns to its service and that is displayed transparently before you complete the booking. The details — deadlines, refund percentages, refund method, force majeure and agency-caused non-performance — are set out in the section 'Cancellation & Refunds' above. platformServices.content: EventBliss provides public listings, a digital booking workflow, payment processing via Stripe for online bookings, support services, and marketing. EventBliss acts solely as an intermediary and is not a party to the service contract between Agency and Customer.

agencyDuties.title: Agency Obligations
agencyDuties.content: The Agency must provide services with proper quality, comply with all legal and tax obligations, keep profile data and calendar accurate, respond to inquiries within 24 hours on business days, and display legally binding prices including VAT.

platformFee.title: Platform Fee
platformFee.content: EventBliss charges a 10% platform fee on all bookings, regardless of payment method. For online bookings, the fee is deducted automatically before payout. For on-site payments, the Agency must remit the fee within 14 days after service delivery. Each completed on-site booking must be marked as delivered within 48 hours.

paymentModes.title: Payment Modes and Equal Treatment
paymentModes.content: Both online (Stripe) and on-site payments are recognized as Platform bookings. The choice of payment method does not exempt the Agency from the platform fee. Encouraging customers to pay outside the Platform is prohibited and constitutes a breach of Section 6.

exclusivity.title: EXCLUSIVITY AND ANTI-CIRCUMVENTION
exclusivity.leadIn: Breach of this Section 6 entitles EventBliss to immediate termination, contractual penalties, and suspension of the Agency profile.

period.title: Exclusivity Period
period.content: Any customer referred via the Platform is exclusive to EventBliss for 18 months from first contact, including follow-up bookings and related derivative business.

prohibition.title: Prohibition of Circumvention
prohibition.content: After cancellation, the Agency may not offer a comparable service off-platform. The Agency may not encourage cash payment on site when the listing is set to online payment, share customer contacts with third parties, run parallel bookings via own channels, or induce customers to cancel platform bookings in favor of off-platform arrangements.

dataPurpose.title: Purpose Limitation of Customer Data
dataPurpose.content: Customer contact data received from the Platform is subject to strict purpose limitation per GDPR Art. 5(1)(b). Use is limited to fulfilling the specific booking; building own customer lists, marketing, newsletters, and upselling beyond the booking are prohibited.

penalty.title: Contractual Penalty
penalty.content: For each proven violation of Sections 6.1 to 6.3, the Agency owes a contractual penalty equal to 2× the total booking value (minimum EUR 500) plus a lump sum of EUR 10,000 per incident, payable without further notice. Additional damages remain reserved.

audit.title: Audit Right on Reasonable Suspicion
audit.content: Upon reasonable suspicion, EventBliss may request communications logs, payment records, and booking calendar extracts within 14 days. Refusal or late delivery raises a rebuttable presumption of breach.

cancellationRates.title: Cancellation Rate Rules
cancellationRates.leadIn: Excessive agency-initiated cancellations harm the Platform. EventBliss continuously monitors cancellation rates.

window.title: Reference Window
window.content: The rate is calculated on a rolling 30-day window, counting only agency-initiated cancellations relative to confirmed bookings.

warning.title: Early Warning at 15%
warning.content: Above 15%, the Agency is warned automatically and must attend a mandatory partner management call within 14 days.

suspension.title: Suspension and Delisting at 20%
suspension.content: Above 20%, EventBliss may — after 7 days' written notice — pause listings, pause the entire profile, or remove the Agency from the Platform. Measures lift once the rate falls below 15%.

exceptions.title: Exceptions with Evidence
exceptions.content: Force majeure, customer misinformation, customer payment default, and legitimate safety or hygiene concerns are excluded from the calculation if timely documented and supported by evidence.

qualityCriteria.title: Listing and Quality Criteria
qualityCriteria.content: Response time under 24 hours on business days, minimum average rating of 4.0/5.0 over the last 20 bookings, complete profiles, legally binding prices per PAngV, and valid usage rights for all imagery.

liability.title: Liability and Warranty
liability.content: The Agency is solely liable for service delivery and incidents at the venue. EventBliss is liable only for platform availability within market standards. The Agency indemnifies EventBliss against third-party claims arising from defective service delivery and must maintain business liability insurance of at least EUR 1,000,000 (personal injury) and EUR 500,000 (property damage).

dataProtection.title: Data Protection and Processing
dataProtection.content: Each party acts as an independent controller for its own processing purposes. Where EventBliss processes data on behalf of the Agency, the separate Data Processing Agreement under GDPR Art. 28 applies. Data breaches involving platform customers must be reported to EventBliss within 24 hours of discovery.

termTermination.title: Term and Termination
termTermination.content: The agreement runs indefinitely. Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days' written notice to month's end. EventBliss may terminate immediately for breaches of Section 6, repeated cancellation rate violations, substantial payment default, or insolvency. support.title: Help & Support
support.subtitle: Find quick answers about EventBliss below — or contact our team directly. We're happy to help with your events, Premium, bookings and your account.

contact.title: Contact us

emailCard.title: Email support
emailCard.desc: The fastest way to reach us. Please include the email address of your EventBliss account — and your booking number for marketplace bookings.

contact.responseTime: We usually reply within 24–48 hours on working days.

createEvent.q: How do I create an event?
createEvent.a: Tap the plus button (Create event) on the home screen, choose the event type (e.g. bachelor party, birthday, wedding), set a name and date — done. As the organiser you can then invite guests, create tasks, build a schedule, start polls and manage the budget. Creating events is free.

joinCode.q: How do I join an event with an invitation code?
joinCode.a: Open the app and choose 'Join event', then enter the 6-character invitation code — or simply tap the invitation link you received. You'll be added to the event right away. If the code doesn't work, ask the organiser for a fresh link — codes can expire when the organiser resets them.

premiumBuy.q: How do I get EventBliss Premium?
premiumBuy.a:
You can buy Premium in two ways:

• In the app: open the Premium page and complete the purchase via the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android). Subscriptions renew automatically; the Lifetime option is a one-time purchase.
• On the website: sign in on event-bliss.com and buy via our payment provider Stripe (credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and more).

Premium unlocks unlimited events, all party games, AI features and more.

premiumRestore.q: I bought Premium but it's not active — how do I restore my purchase?
premiumRestore.a: Open the Premium page in the app and tap 'Restore purchases'. Make sure you are signed in with the same Apple ID / Google account you used for the original purchase — and with the same EventBliss account. If you bought Premium on the website, sign in to the app with the same EventBliss account; it syncs automatically. Still not working? Email support@event-bliss.com and attach your purchase receipt.

premiumCancelApp.q: How do I cancel a subscription bought in the app (App Store / Google Play)?
premiumCancelApp.a:
Subscriptions bought in the app are managed exclusively by Apple or Google — EventBliss cannot cancel them for you:

• iPhone/iPad: Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions → EventBliss → Cancel subscription.
• Android: Google Play app → profile icon → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → EventBliss → Cancel.

Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, otherwise it renews automatically. After cancelling, Premium stays active until the end of the paid period. Deleting the app does NOT cancel a subscription.

premiumCancelWeb.q: How do I cancel a subscription bought on the website?
premiumCancelWeb.a: Subscriptions purchased on event-bliss.com (via Stripe) can be cancelled in your account on the website — or simply email support@event-bliss.com from your account email address and we'll cancel it for you. The cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; you keep Premium until then.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: In the app: Profile → Settings → Delete account. This permanently deletes your account and your events (backup copies are purged within 30 days; payment records subject to statutory retention are kept for the prescribed period). Important: an active App Store / Google Play subscription is NOT cancelled by deleting your account — cancel it first in your store's subscription settings.

exportData.q: Can I get a copy of my data (data export)?
exportData.a: Yes. Under Art. 20 GDPR you can receive the data you provided in a machine-readable format. Email support@event-bliss.com from the email address of your EventBliss account and request a data export — we'll send it within 30 days at the latest, usually much faster.

bookings.q: I have a question or problem with a marketplace booking — who do I contact?
bookings.a: Your service contract is concluded directly with the agency, so first contact the agency via the booking chat in the app — that keeps everything documented. If you can't reach an agreement or the agency doesn't respond, email support@event-bliss.com with your booking number: EventBliss mediates in every case, and buyer protection applies to online payments.

games.q: A party game or the music game (OHRWURM) isn't working — what can I do?
games.a: First check your internet connection and make sure the app is up to date. For the OHRWURM music game: full song playback requires a Spotify Premium account connected in the game; without it, shorter preview clips are played. If a game doesn't start or freezes, fully close and reopen the app. Still stuck? Email support@event-bliss.com with your device model and a short description.

headup.step2: Your friends describe the word to you
headup.step3: Guessed right? Tilt phone forward! Wrong? Tilt back!
headup.step4: Get as many words as possible before time's up
headup.tip: Don't drop your phone — happens more often than you'd think!

category.title: Speed Category
category.tagline: Name things in a category — hesitate and you're out! Speed counts!
category.step1: A category is shown (e.g., "Animals starting with A")
category.step2: Each player takes turns naming a matching item
category.step3: Can't think of one or too slow? You get a point

emojiguess.title: Emoji Guess

emojiguess.step2: Guess which movie, song, or celeb the emojis show
emojiguess.step3: The faster you guess, the more points you get
emojiguess.tip: Think blockbusters — the obvious answer is often right!

fakeorfact.step2: Decide: Is it TRUE or FAKE?
fakeorfact.step3: After your answer, you'll see the explanation
fakeorfact.tip: The craziest facts are usually true!

truthdare.title: Truth or Dare
truthdare.tagline: The party classic — answer honestly or do an embarrassing dare? Your choice!
truthdare.step2: Truth: Answer the question honestly (no matter how embarrassing!)
truthdare.step4: Then it's the next player's turn
truthdare.tip: Dares get bolder with every drink — we didn't say that!

thisorthat.title: This or That
thisorthat.tagline: Pizza or Pasta? Netflix or Cinema? Tough choices ahead!
thisorthat.step3: Compare answers — who's in the majority?
thisorthat.tip: There are no wrong answers — just heated debates!

whoami.title: Who Am I?
whoami.tagline: Ask yes/no questions and figure out who you are — Sherlock would be proud!
whoami.step1: Each player gets a secret person/character assigned
whoami.step2: Ask yes/no questions: "Am I real?" "Am I famous?"
whoami.step3: Combine the clues and guess who you are
whoami.tip: Start broad — "Am I a woman?" eliminates 50%!

bottlespin.title: Spin the Bottle
bottlespin.tagline: The bottle spins... who will it point to? Fun and suspense guaranteed!

bottlespin.tip: Luck decides — no tactics can help you here!

storybuilder.title: Story Builder
storybuilder.tagline: Write the craziest story together — creativity without limits!
storybuilder.step1: A story starter sets the scene
storybuilder.step2: Each player adds one sentence in turns
storybuilder.step3: At the end, the complete story is read aloud
storybuilder.tip: The more absurd your twist, the funnier the story!

sharedquiz.title: Shared Quiz
sharedquiz.tagline: Team quiz battle — who knows more? Show what you've got!
sharedquiz.step1: A question is shown to all players at once
sharedquiz.step2: Everyone picks their answer — no conferring!
sharedquiz.tip: Sometimes the most unlikely answer is the right one!

quickdraw.title: Quick Draw
quickdraw.tagline: Draw fast, guess faster — Picasso would be proud (or horrified)!
quickdraw.step1: You're shown a word to draw
quickdraw.step2: Draw as fast as possible — stick figures are fine!
quickdraw.step4: Faster guesses = more points for everyone
quickdraw.tip: Forget art class — speed is everything here!

splitquiz.title: Split Quiz
splitquiz.tagline: Split knowledge — everyone sees different answers, but only one is right!
splitquiz.step2: Each player sees different answer options
splitquiz.step3: Discuss which answer could be correct
splitquiz.step4: Only the one with the right answer scores
splitquiz.tip: Trust your gut — or the nerd in your group!

hochstapler.title: The Impostor
hochstapler.tagline: One person has no clue — find the impostor! Or be one yourself...
hochstapler.step1: All players get a secret word — ONE gets a different one
hochstapler.step2: Each player describes the word with a single term
hochstapler.step3: Everyone votes: Who is the impostor?
hochstapler.step4: Impostor caught? Others win. Impostor survives? They win!
hochstapler.tip: As the impostor: Be vague enough to blend in, but specific enough to not seem suspicious!

wo-ist-was.title: Where Is It?
wo-ist-was.tagline: 5 different modes — from Memory to Speed to Street View! Geography & observation!
wo-ist-was.step1: Choose one of 5 modes: Memory, Speed, Differences, Map or Street View
wo-ist-was.step2: Memory: Memorize the emoji scene, then answer questions about it
wo-ist-was.step3: Speed: The scene stays visible — who finds the answer fastest?
wo-ist-was.step4: Map: Find cities and countries on the world map — closer = more points
wo-ist-was.step5: Street View: You see a photo — guess which city you're in!
wo-ist-was.tip: In Map mode: Europe is smaller than you think — and Australia is bigger!

flaschendrehen.title: Spin the Bottle
flaschendrehen.tagline: The classic party game! Who will the bottle choose?
flaschendrehen.step1: The bottle spins in the middle
flaschendrehen.step2: Whoever it points to is up
flaschendrehen.step3: Answer the question or complete the dare
flaschendrehen.tip: Karma spins the bottle — be nice to your fellow players!

ohrwurm.title: Ohrwurm
ohrwurm.tagline: Hear the song, place it in the right year — who builds the longest hit timeline first?
ohrwurm.step1: The song plays right inside the app (30s, title & year hidden). You have 60 seconds to place it — otherwise the card is forfeited.
ohrwurm.step2: If you know the title & artist, call them out BEFORE the reveal — that's your bonus chance.
ohrwurm.step3: Place the song in your OWN timeline: which two years does it belong between?
ohrwurm.step4: Counter: others with at least 1 🎣 challenge before the reveal. If you were wrong and the counter was right, they steal the card AND get their 🎣 back — otherwise the spent 🎣 is gone.
ohrwurm.step5: Bonus: win the card + correctly call title & artist → +1 🎣. Do it all (placed right + called) in under 10 seconds → +2 🎣 (speed bonus). First to 6/10/15 cards wins.
ohrwurm.tip: 🎣 Hooks are your jokers: COUNTER (challenge & steal), SWAP (1 🎣 for a new card) and BONUS/SPEED (title + artist, extra fast). Everyone starts with 3 🎣, max 5.

drueck-das-wort.title: Press the Word

drueck-das-wort.step2: Tap the correct word from the options — fast!
drueck-das-wort.step3: Correct? Next word! Wrong? Points deducted!
drueck-das-wort.step4: Most correct words at the end wins
drueck-das-wort.tip: Don't tap frantically — one wrong click costs more than a second of thinking!

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What happens if I miss the 50% discount offer?
faq.a1: You'll keep the price of €49 (Professional) or €149 (Enterprise) forever – even if we later raise it to €98/€298. Your rate gets locked at booking.
faq.a2: Yes. Upgrade is instant, downgrade at the end of the billing period. No notice periods, no cancellation fees.
faq.q3: How many users will I actually reach?
faq.a3: EventBliss grows via 3 viral loops (games, surveys, TV). With Professional you're in priority search – wedding couples, party hosts and companies find you where they plan.
faq.a4: Commission only applies to actually booked services, settled automatically via Stripe. Starter pays 25%, Professional & Enterprise only 10% – quickly offsets the monthly fee.
faq.q5: Do I need experience or setup help?
faq.a5: No. Profile + first service listing are live in under 10 minutes. Enterprise customers also get a dedicated onboarding call.
